basis.approval_note: The latest user authorised re-estimation, integration and mandatory-lab-only attendance. Revised minutes are proposed for review; earlier full-coverage/standalone-verification assumptions are superseded.
basis.requirements: Requirements/master_requirements.md sections 9, 13-19, 26, 29 and 34; existing source-map rules retained.

task_semantics: All tasks are unstarted. Default requirement status is required; only RecSys numericals is conditional. Readiness flags describe input availability, not study completion.

Each task charges its revised components once. The seven verification checkpoints have zero additional minutes because their checks are included in integrated_into_task_id; do not create separate calendar blocks for them.
Dependencies retain preparation before closure. Components sharing session_group_id can be performed in one focused session; project questionnaires remain separate sessions after project refresh.

Local sources are resolved by estimate_id against logical_unit_ids in source_map.json. Preserve primary/supporting roles and RecSys pairs; reuse shared references without standalone tasks or duplicate workload.
External resource IDs are bound by estimate ID below; execution limits and access notes are in resource_research.md. A selected resource is not a requirement to finish its whole collection.
General DSA stays independent from OA. Representative selection must protect breadth and remain fixed when the schedule is prepared; no problem bank or adaptive weakness expansion is created here.

Practice subtasks may later be interleaved by topic once their relevant refresh is done; the aggregate dependencies express the preparation-to-closure sequence, not a requirement for uninterrupted multi-hour blocks.

additional_local_context.final_mixed_mock: Reuse the sources/resources of its prerequisite preparation tasks; no additional source set.

execution_conditions.leetcode_execution_access: Check sign-in, available exercises and chosen language execution at use time; no paid subscription is assumed. No account operation was performed here.
execution_conditions.mongodb_environment_available: A usable MongoDB practice environment and tutorial data must be available. Neither provisioning nor substantial setup time is authorised or added by this inventory.
execution_conditions.reliable_cv_material_and_scope: Await reliable lecturer CV materials and confirmed scope before refining the mandatory reserved preparation; no external syllabus investigation.
execution_conditions.recsys_numericals_retained: A later explicit redundancy decision must determine whether the separate numericals task is needed. It is not an approved cut and remains included in totals.

resource_resolution_note: Selected resources are retained without reinspection. The revised estimates remove stale resource-selection flags while preserving actual missing material, uncertain fluency and runtime limitations.

constraints_for_later_scheduling.rule: At least one genuine midsem self-study block on every date from 2026-09-10 through 2026-09-16 inclusive. College attendance does not count; no daily blocks are assigned here.
Each project revision precedes its separate ChatGPT questionnaire; all three project pairs remain required.

Checking is integrated with targeted refresh/practice. Legacy verification IDs are completion checkpoints inside named hosts: SQL review for DBMS, MongoDB review for backend, own preparation for other subjects. No automatic separate verification block.
The full mixed ChatGPT mock belongs on the night of 2026-09-16 after major LSEG preparation, represented by its explicit dependencies. Midsem tasks are not prerequisites for this mock.
Do not silently cut required tasks, expand weak areas automatically, count OA as DSA, or invent CV scope. RecSys numericals remains conditional and visible.

Feasibility was recalculated against the revised estimates and the mandatory-lab-only attendance rule; see Planning/feasibility.md. Result: feasible with a 5-minute aggregate margin including the conditional RecSys numericals (50 minutes without). Day-level and dependency checks pass. Scheduling must honour the recorded mock-placement rules on 2026-09-16. No schedule has been produced.
The 20% attendance target is removed completely. Only Monday 14 September 2026 IWT lab, 10:00–12:00, must be attended; no other class attendance is required.
